title: Tethered to stone: how rock and water availability shaped early desert occupation
title_zh: 系于石头：岩石与水资源如何塑造早期沙漠占据
abstract: Fresh water in deserts often points to sites with signs of early humans and stone tools. But, in Arabia’s Rub’ al Khali region, water alone does not predict occupation.
abstract_zh: 沙漠中的淡水常指向存在早期人类和石器遗迹的遗址。然而，在阿拉伯的鲁卜哈利地区，仅有水资源并不能预测人类占据情况。
snippet: Fresh water in deserts often points to sites with signs of early humans and stone tools. But, in Arabia’s Rub’ al Khali region, water alone does not predict occupation.
